prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair a Mac image-inspector workflow that currently blocks editing. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. Color inspection opens a document-modal sheet on every click, preventing comparison with the image. The inspector loses its target when another document activates and closing it saves unrelated edits.

criteria.task_completion: Patch a suitable modeless panel contract with clear active-document scope, live inspection and close semantics, keyboard/focus access and behavior across multiple windows.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the panels guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch a suitable modeless panel contract with clear active-document scope, live inspection and close semantics, keyboard/focus access and behavior across multiple windows.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
